packageRules.description: One weekly PR for everything that is not a major bump

Jupyter base image tags name an Ubuntu release (ubuntu-26.04). Read the tag as a version so a newer release arrives as a major PR, and pin its digest so rebuilds of the same tag arrive too. Upstream stops rebuilding a tag once it moves to the next release
JJava tags look like 1.0-a8, which is not semver

customManagers.description: ARG <NAME>_VERSION=<value> lines in the Containerfile, each preceded by a renovate comment
